items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: I did Clash By Night on Broadway with Tallulah Bankhead.

ctx.x: Well, I knew I couldn't hold on to it...keep it, because how could you have a dance hall, have a building, and have a dance hall, that's dark six days and then an occasional dance and then, you know, maybe you'll make it and maybe you won't. So that was...finally I gave up and in '48 I went to Europe instead of Willie "the Lion" Smith, and then I just took a different course. My life took a different course.

I began playing more in New York and then I did Tambourines to Glory with Langston.* I did Clash By Night on Broadway with Tallulah Bankhead. I did another thing called The Last House on the Left with Irish Owen ...he was a playwrite and a producer. The show was so bad, until the actors asked him to cancel it. It closed in Boston.
